messages:
emily: Quick async: post-launch micro-wave items popped up. Three tickets: (1) BIGCORP embed staleness (customer-facing), (2) chat p95 regression after batch-tuner change, (3) token counter tooltip that helps clarity for self-serve. We need owners + priorities.

raj: Can someone paste the BIGCORP ticket? If it's reproducible in staging we should hotpatch.

maria: Ticket BIG-307: search results showing older vectors intermittently; started 2026-03-20 after a compaction rollout. Customer flagged as business-impacting.

kai: Infra note: compaction rollout increased concurrency; we saw "kv_compact_race" warnings around 2026-03-20 03:40 UTC and a short window of increased cache misses. Might explain stale reads.

noah: Tooltip is tiny (copy + assistive text). Design: 2–3 hrs, dev ~4–6 hrs. Good quick win for UX.

emily: Proposal: BIG-307 = P0 hotfix (rollback compaction concurrency + run reconcile), p95 chat = P1 (instrument + triage), tooltip = P3 (next sprint unless we have spare sprint capacity). Agree?

raj: I'll take BIG-307. Plan: revert concurrency flag, add a one-shot reconcile job for recent writes, add a small integration test that replays the customer's trace. Est 1.5 dev days + 0.5 for tests. Need SRE to coordinate canary.

kai: I can repro in staging and run a 5% canary. I'll prepare a rollback playbook and smoke checks. Also capture KV metrics during canary.

qa-bot: CI: branch created hotfix/big-307-reconcile-1819994321. Tests queued. (automated)

maria: Success criteria for BIG-307: search recall back to baseline for 24h, no stale-vector alerts for 48h, customer confirmation. Ill hold comms and only let them know after 25% canary success.

noah: Ill draft the tooltip and add a screenshot to the ticket. If a dev has 4 hours spare they can land it quickly.

emily: Decision log: BIG-307 -> P0 hotfix (owners: raj + kai). Chat p95 -> P1 investigate (owner raj). Tooltip -> P3 (owner noah). Plan: staging canary today, prod rollout by gradual ramp if green. Follow-up sync 8:30am PT tomorrow.

raj: Opening PR now with reconcile script and a small smoke harness.

kai: After canary, Ill run a p95 baseline replay for chat to see if the batching tweak correlates. If it does, well revert thresholds for the short term.

emily: Thanks team  capturing this for the roadmap notes and backlog. Will update the ticket priorities accordingly. :thumbsup:
